gaps.sentence: She goes to the gym twice ___ week.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a week' — rates take 'a' (= per). The other gap is 'the gym'.

gaps.sentence: She got ___ injury during the warm-up.
gaps.explanation: 'An injury' — vowel sound; 'during the warm-up' is the specific one.

gaps.sentence: He plays ___ violin in the youth orchestra.
She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.

gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: The car crashed into a wall at ___ speed of 90 km/h.
gaps.explanation: 'At a speed of…' — 'a' is part of this fixed phrase.
